# A contact from the iPhone with a picture over 512 KiB (TECHNIK 5.5): the
# server shrinks it and answers without ETag (RFC 6352 6.3.2), so the
# device fetches what is stored; the rest of the card stays.
> PUT /carddav/alex/addressbooks/kontakte/C0FFEE00-0000-4000-8000-000000000001.vcf
> Auth: alex
> Content-Type: text/vcard
> If-None-Match: *
> Body: big-photo.vcf
< status 201
< no-header ETag

> GET /carddav/alex/addressbooks/kontakte/C0FFEE00-0000-4000-8000-000000000001.vcf
> Auth: alex
< status 200
< header-has ETag "
< photo-below 262145
< body-has PHOTO;ENCODING=b;TYPE=JPEG:
< body-has X-APPLE-SUBLOCALITY:Ehrenfeld
< body-has UID:C0FFEE00-0000-4000-8000-000000000001
< body-lacks X-ABCROP-RECTANGLE
< save stored header ETag

# The same card again (If-Match on the stored state): shrunk the same way,
# no write, still without ETag – 204.
> PUT /carddav/alex/addressbooks/kontakte/C0FFEE00-0000-4000-8000-000000000001.vcf
> Auth: alex
> Content-Type: text/vcard
> If-Match: {saved:stored}
> Body: big-photo.vcf
< status 204
< no-header ETag

> GET /carddav/alex/addressbooks/kontakte/C0FFEE00-0000-4000-8000-000000000001.vcf
> Auth: alex
< status 200
< header ETag {saved:stored}
